title: A1 — define what constitutes a recorded request
concern: Key on initial user message misses corrective retries, vision content blocks, system prompt and schema; prompt-change re-record trigger not established.
proposed: Fingerprint model, full response format, ordered messages incl. system and corrective; normalise only identified transport differences; vision explicit or unrecorded; record fixture identity.
response: v2 D4: full fingerprint incl. options; normaliser fields named only from a record-vs-replay diff; vision (tier3) explicitly unrecorded; fixture identity recorded. Re-record trigger claim dropped.

title: A2 — application-owned OpenAI adapter; call-time fal facade
concern: Integration package cannot import app modules; cached client precedes credential check; conditional fal export would be load-time.
proposed: API-owned getOpenAIClient adapter delegating to the package; embeddings uses selector first; fal forwarding facade resolving per call; selection before credential gate; classifier seam preserved.
response: v2 D2 adopts this as proposed.

title: A3 — prove recordings through their consumers
concern: Interception and provenance do not show the chain passes real validators or that a failure becomes an app outcome; startup calls exceed baseline recordings.
proposed: Consumer-level evidence for chain, PNG, one error; startup unmatched calls fail visibly, never fall through.
response: v2 D7 'Through the consumers'; D4 states boot-time unrecorded calls fail visibly.
